observations: Grey chest freezer shown sitting on its styrofoam base.
Brand 'Haier Thermocool' is clearly visible on the lid sticker and front logo.
Lid sticker advertises '100 HOURS FROZEN RETENTION' and a '3 Years Warranty'.
A green indicator light is active on the front control panel, suggesting the unit is powered.
The unit is not inside a cardboard carton as claimed.
The interior of the freezer is not shown.
No manufacturer's data plate showing model or capacity is visible in the photos.

Photo 0 and 2 show the Haier Thermocool branding.
The freezer is shown out of the carton in all provided photos.

risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's specification plate on the back or side of the unit.
risks.if_unproven: as the smallest capacity model of this series

risks.proof: A photo of the interior showing frost or a thermometer reading.

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's specification plate showing the model number and capacity in liters.
Photo of the interior of the freezer.
